issue_request: FHIR-18373 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request raised against the STU3 extensibility examples. It asked that the patient consent extension example link to the Consent resource and indicate that extensions are not the preferred mechanism for representing patient consent.
initial_application: The issue was applied by a0224fc031511620b84439829f0eb723a7796a15, which changed source/extensibility-examples.html to wrap "other approaches to this problem" in a link to consent.html and to say those approaches are "possible and preferred" while keeping the extension solely as an example of the extension process.
additional_context: The current source still contains the consent.html link and preferred-approach warning in the Patient Consent for Record Sharing example. The Consent resource remains active in source/fhir.ini. The same historical commit also handled FHIR-18392, but that related issue already has a combined-branch audit commit. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the published issue and no source correction is needed.

related_jiras.note: The same historical commit also moved the extensibility examples menu, but FHIR-18392 already has its own combined-branch audit commit and was not republished here.
